title: bug(plugin-detail): a percent summary chip states two different percentages — its text and its own bar are computed by different rules
body:
Found while implementing objectui#8464 (the summary chip's object-value display). ⛔ Not fixed there — a different defect on the same lines, filed rather than ridden along.

## What

`packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx`, the `effectiveSummaryFields.map` render beside the page H1. The `percent` branch computes its TEXT and its BAR from the same number by two different rules:

```
display = `${num}%`;                                   // the text
const normalized = num <= 1 ? num * 100 : num;         // the bar
percentValue = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, normalized));
```

So for a stored `0.123` the one chip states two different percentages at once: the label reads `0.123%` and the bar beside it fills to 12.3%.

## Measured

Rendered `DetailView` with `summaryFields: ['ratio']`, `fields: [{ name: 'ratio', type: 'percent' }]`, `data: { ratio: 0.123 }`, on `ed971e8fc`:

| what | value |
|---|---|
| chip text | `0.123%` |
| chip `aria-label` | `ratio: 0.123%` |
| bar fill width | `12.3%` |
| what `PercentCellRenderer` prints for the same value | `12%` |

The last row is the cross-band half: the body grid and the highlights strip draw `12%` for the value the chip calls `0.123%`.

## Not ruled

Which of the two the chip should follow is a product question — `PercentCellRenderer`'s rule (and the bar's) treats a value at or below 1 as a ratio; the text treats it as an already-scaled percentage. Whoever takes it should decide once and make the text and the bar read the same number, rather than fixing one of them.

## Dedup

Run. Channel: MCP `search_issues` (repo-scoped REST `/search/issues` is refused in this container — "sessions are bound to their configured repositories"). Its control fired on the same session: a query for the summary-chip object-value defect returned objectui#8464 itself as the top hit, so this is not a false zero. Query `summary chip percent text disagrees with its progress bar ratio stored value detail header` returned one closed, unrelated item (objectui#4596). No duplicate found.
